title: Bubbling Magma Pool
description: A wide pool of molten rock churns sluggishly in a natural depression, its surface cracking and reforming in patterns of orange and black. Cooled crusts along the edges crumble into glittering ember dust, and bits of debris from above float briefly before sinking into the glow. The radiant heat is almost unbearable, but strangely soothing at a distance.

choices.label: Skim the cooled edges
choices.description: Scrape the ember-rich crust from the hardened margins of the pool.

choices.label: Fish out debris
choices.description: Use a long pole to drag floating debris to the edge before it melts.

choices.label: Rest near the warmth
choices.description: Sit at a safe distance and let the deep heat ease the party's wounds.
